steps.note: a screen at 440,100 400x360 with two rectangles on it, nothing picked. Its name sits between y 82 and y 96

the pointer resting on empty room of a screen that is NOT picked: a drag there sweeps a band, so cue must be screen-sweep and cursor must stay the plain arrow, the same one bare canvas wears for the same gesture
option held over that same room: option dragging a screen USED to duplicate it and now sweeps, so cue must still be screen-sweep and cursor must be arrow, never dragCopy
the same spot once the screen is picked: a drag there carries the screen, so cue must be screen-move and cursor must be openHand
option held where the screen would move: the drag leaves the original behind, so cue must be screen-copy and cursor must be dragCopy
the name above a screen that is not picked: it is the one grab that moves the screen without picking it first, so cue must be name-grab and cursor must be openHand
resting on a rectangle sitting on the screen: nothing about the screen is being offered, so cue must be none and cursor must be arrow
with nothing picked, a drag across that empty room still sweeps a band: the screen must still be at 440,100 and the two rectangles must be what is picked
and a drag from the same room once the screen is picked still moves it: the screen must now be at 490,150
the screen is back at 440,100 and the walk leaves nothing behind
